description: This PHP script manages WiFi spectrum analysis diagnostics, including session handling, retrieving neighboring WiFi data, translating MAC addresses, rearranging data fields, and outputting results in JSON format.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to uppercase and formats it with colons if not already present.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Rearranges a comma-separated string by inserting '-'.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Retrieves neighboring WiFi diagnostic results, processes MAC addresses, and compiles data for output.
